formulas.tex: \term{drop}{\delta}(p) = \term{ownHeight}{h_p} - \max_{q \in \mathrm{Ring}(p)\setminus\{p\}} \term{ringHeight}{h_q},\quad p \text{ is a summit} \iff h_p \text{ is the disc maximum and } \delta(p) \ge \term{minimumDrop}{\delta_{\min}}
formulas.ascii: p is a summit iff it is the strict maximum of its metric disc (ties: lowest row-major index wins) and drop(p) = h(p) - max(h(q)) over the disc ring >= minimumDrop; the disc is ((dx*cx)^2 + (dy*cy)^2) <= radius^2 at the centre row; reject policy: a disc leaving the grid or touching nodata is no summit; drop is +Infinity with an empty ring; NaN where there is no summit
